findings: Guide preparation builds separate layer route_regions from ADDR2 1.5mm and MUX 1.25mm halos, with via/ground regions derived from the union.
The physical-port solver starts phys from each routeRegions[layer], then subtracts actual foreign/protected/contact copper. Its phys field already includes a heuristic layer boundary.
Signal/ground via domains have additional viaRegion/groundRegion and local-domain clipping. A diagnostic must distinguish those from actual copper, reference and return constraints.
The graph also limits signal transitions using nativeGuideSwitchBound; a failed bounded search is not a general physical impossibility proof.
The observed 5 macro expansions and 2 admitted assignments did not reach a complete route or full audit.
